summary: The product Knowledge API remains fsgg.knowledge/1 with its 10 MiB current-record budget, optimistic revision capture, writer lock and ordinary Git history, distinct from organization Atlas fsgg.atlas/1. Delivered SDD source now supports optional fsgg.owner-guidance/1 declarations carried by verified selected Drivers bytes. Owner-supplied body-only Markdown activates generically after ordinary provider scaffold materialization; doctor reports drift without writes and confirmed upgrade preserves authored text outside one valid marked block. Absent or provider-less devRepoInit provenance stays neutral; a local descriptor grants no write authority. Owner-guidance contained reads reject unsafe/link/nonregular paths. Writes recheck exact target/config/prerequisite bytes before atomic replacement, without race-free CAS or cross-file atomicity. Malformed markers, differing prerequisites and concurrent edits refuse activation and remain visible. The product Knowledge API and history are unchanged. Current skill distribution uses .claude and .agents; codex/claude agent targets resolve separate root Markdown files. Owner payload and generic mechanism source delivery do not establish compatible package publication or installed adoption. Those require a payload-bearing Drivers release, SDD dependency adoption and fresh downloaded-only scaffold plus retained doctor/upgrade acceptance.
title: Project Knowledge stays separate from owner-declared Atlas guidance
